_help: Messages ambassadors copy with one tap. Edit freely. Placeholders: {link} = their tracked link for that channel, {school} = school name, {name} = ambassador first name. Keep it short and lowercase. Never ask for ratings or reviews here.

messages.label: group chat
messages.text: random but a friend of mine at penn built an app that pulls all your canvas/gradescope deadlines into one place and reminds you before stuff closes. it's free, i've been using it. {link}

messages.label: dm follow-up
messages.text: hey! you mentioned deadlines sneaking up on you. this is the app i was talking about, takes 2 min to connect canvas: {link} tell me if anything's confusing and i'll pass it on to the people who built it.

messages.label: in person (say it, don't paste it)
messages.text: it's called smooth. it pulls your canvas and gradescope deadlines into one list and reminds you before they close. my friend at penn built it, it's free. want the link?

messages.label: club or org chat
messages.text: not club related but useful: smooth puts all your canvas/gradescope deadlines in one place with reminders. free, built by students at penn, i'm helping them get it to {school}. {link}

posting_tips: post once per place. if it gets downvoted or removed, let it go. don't repost the same thing.
say it like you'd say it. edit the message so it sounds like you.
on anonymous apps, no links in the first post if the app strips them. put 'smooth for students' and people can search it.
if someone asks whether you're involved, say yes, you're an ambassador. honesty does better than hype.
posters only where the campus allows them. check the board's rules first. never over someone else's poster.
reviews: if you like the app, an honest review helps. never ask for stars, never trade anything for a review. apple bans incentivised reviews and it would put the app at risk.
